resolved.evidence: In q8, every option now acts on the two empty fields: a 「画面の流れとデータの欄に、使う言語やファイルの分け方まで書く」, b 「…AIが補うので空のまま渡す」, c 「…思いつく例外や条件をすべて書く」. The key d 「画面名と保存する項目名だけを、自分で決めて書き足す」 no longer repeats the stem. A learner now has to judge how much to write, and d matches the lesson's own rule (ex-data 「項目名だけで十分です」, s1-b4 prompt 「画面名を「→」でつなぐ」).

scores.evidence: There are four can-do objectives, each assessed inline and in the exam: o1 q1/q5, o2 q2/q6, o3 q3/q7, o4 q4/q8/q10/q9. The rewritten q8 still targets o4 at evaluate: it judges how much to fill in before handing the plan over.
hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「グラフや分類が並んだ画面がすぐにできました。でも、ほしかったのは「月の途中で食費の使いすぎに気づける」ことでした」). It has no trivia, and the ungraded predict q0 leads into o2.

Prerequisites are stated, s1-b1 and ex-data recall ch0 and ch1, and terms are defined before the quizzes. The rewritten q4 explanation still names 「Claude Codeの公式ガイド（Anthropic）」, a tool neither ch0 nor ch1 introduces. It now glosses 仕様書 inline as 「（企画書のような文書）」.

Each segment teaches one idea and introduces at most 2 new terms (壁打ち / 目的・機能 / MVP・MoSCoW / 1枚企画書・PRD). Lint shows 0 sentence or paragraph warnings, and every section has a table, diagram, steps block or check. Section 2-3 is dense (lead, definitions, 6 steps, diagram, a long model plan in s2-b3.expect, quiz), but it is the worked example.

s3-steps is a 6-step worked example with subgoal titles. Each step gives its reason (「目的の1文は、あとの手順の物差しになります」, 「決めないと、AIが推測で項目を選びます」), and the result is a full model plan in s2-b3.expect. There is no faded step in this lesson; fading happens in vibe-ch2-practice.

Every segment has an inline check in a new context (散歩, 送迎当番, 読書記録), and the exam has apply and evaluate items. q8 no longer gives its key away: all four options name 「画面の流れとデータの欄」, so the choice turns on how much to write, not on word matching.

All four misconceptions from the brief are still corrected in the body (s1-b5, s3-b1, s5-b1, s2-table), and most wrong-option feedback names its belief in 2 sentences or fewer. In the rewritten q8, though, option c's kept feedback ends 「先に、空いている見出しを自分で埋めます」. That tells the learner to do what option c already does, so it no longer corrects the over-specification belief.

s2-b4 is a 3-node process diagram whose labels match the text (今月の残り画面, 食費の入力画面). Its caption states the takeaway (「Mustだけなら、最初の版の画面は2つで足りる」), it has alt text and a description, and the lesson has no decorative images.

s1-b5 asks the learner to try s1-b4 with their own idea and compare the result with 「期待される結果」. s2-b3 gives a full model plan. The hint-ladder practice was split into vibe-ch2-practice, so this lesson meets only the anchor-3 level (a hands-on task with the expected result).

summary-points has 4 takeaways and comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection prompt and a next step. There are 6 flashcards; the reworded card-goal (「目的は「誰が・どんな場面で・どうなれる」の形で書きます。機能は、目的を果たすための手段です。」) still matches s2-defs.

The rewritten q4 explanation makes the same claim as before (useful specs state what is out of scope), and s3-check still cites cc-best-practices. The new q8 key and explanation (「名前だけで十分です。」) agree with ex-data and s1-b4. I found no factual errors.

The changed text is です・ます with no banned phrases (lint clean). card-goal now ends in です・ます (「…の形で書きます。…手段です。」), while the other cards end in noun phrases (card-kabeuchi 「…こと。」, card-mvp 「…版。」). The style is mixed but not a rule break.
Every changed string has both jp and en (q4 explanation, q8 options a–d and explanation, card-goal), and lint locale checks are clean. No text is baked into images.

mustFix.issue: This regression comes from the q8 rewrite. Option c now reads 「画面の流れとデータの欄に、思いつく例外や条件をすべて書く」, so the learner who picks it has already filled the empty headings. Its kept feedback ends 「先に、空いている見出しを自分で埋めます。」 / "First fill in the empty headings yourself." That tells them to do what they already did, and it never says how much is enough, which is the actual misconception.
mustFix.fix: Replace q8 option c feedback. JP: 「細かい条件の多くは、作って試すと見えてきます。いまは画面名と項目名を決めれば十分です。」 EN: "Many details only show up once you build and try. For now, deciding the screen names and field names is enough." Leave the feedback for options a and b as it is.

niceToHave: s3-check q4 explanation: the rewrite kept 「Claude Codeの公式ガイド（Anthropic）」, which neither ch0 nor ch1 introduces. Replace it with 「AIツールの開発元Anthropicのガイドも、役に立つ仕様書（企画書のような文書）には範囲外を書く、としています。」 and keep cite cc-best-practices.
summary-cards card-goal: the other five backs end in noun phrases. For consistency, use 「目的は「誰が・どんな場面で・どうなれる」の形で書く1文。機能は、目的を果たすための手段。」, or move all cards to です・ます. The ja-editor decides.

check-quiz q8 option a EN: "Fill the screen-flow and data fields down to the language and how files are split" reads awkwardly. Consider "In the screen-flow and data fields, also specify the programming language and how files are split".

s2-why: asking 「なぜ？」 only once yields intermediate reasons (s2-table rows 2–3) that do not fit the 「誰が・どんな場面で・どうなれる」 form. Replace with 「ほしい[[機能]]が浮かんだら、「なぜそれがほしいの？」と自分に聞き返します。答えがまだ手段なら、もう1回聞きます。」 (carried over, unchanged block).
s2-check q2 option a feedback 「見られると何がうれしいのかを聞くと、目的が見えてきます。」 nearly gives the key to exam q6 c. Consider 「見られた結果、保護者がどうなれるかを考えると、目的が見えてきます。」 (carried over).
summary-next points to drafts/vibe-ch2-practice.lesson.json, which course.json does not list yet. Publish both lessons together (carried over).
summary: The blocker from the last round is fixed. All four q8 options now act on the empty screen-flow and data fields, so the item tests judgment rather than word matching, and active rises to 4. One regression remains from that rewrite: option c's kept feedback (「先に、空いている見出しを自分で埋めます。」) tells the learner to do what option c already does. Replace it with the given feedback on how much is enough.
